plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-13 from the official Southern Utah University 2026-2027 General Catalog (current edition, catoid=28) Mathematics - Actuarial Science Emphasis program page (poid=10875) and its linked official degree map, 'Mathematics & Mathematics Education Degree Maps (2026-2027)', tab 'Actuarial Science (Campus)' (the workbook's Index lists Online as N/A for this program), last updated/reviewed July 27, 2026. Semester placement is the university's official sample 4-year campus academic plan (SUU Program Maps, 2026-2027), which the source itself labels a guide only; students confirm specifics in Degree Works with a Student Success Advisor. Every semester's courses sum to the map's printed semester total (16/14/16/14/16/15/15/14) and the plan to the catalog's printed Total Credits, BS Degree: 120. Per the catalog, all courses must be passed with a C (2.0) or better to be counted in the major. The catalog's Curriculum (61 credits) is exercised exactly by the map: Support Core 6 (ECON 2010 in Fall Year 1 and ECON 2020 in Spring Year 2) and Core Requirements 55, comprising the fifteen named core courses (49 credits), the 'Complete One of the Following' choice exercised as the map's 'CS/MATH Programming or Applied Math Course*' row in Spring Year 2 carrying the catalog's four options, and the 3-credit upper-division MATH Elective Course exercised as the map's 'MATH Major Upper-division Elective* (MATH 3190 rec.)' row in Spring Year 3. The map's Spring Year 2 'GE Physical Sciences*' row is recorded at the printed 5 credits; the catalog and the map both recommend PHYS 2210 and PHYS 2215 to fulfill that breadth area. The catalog's BS (12) and GE (28+) blocks overlap the major and free electives per the catalog's own notes, so the catalog blocks do not sum arithmetically to 120; the map's free-elective rows (26 credits, plus 9 credits of free upper-division electives) carry the balance as printed. Catalog course titles are recorded where the map shortens them (e.g. MATH 3700 Probability and Statistics).
